changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.87[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]All four tracking services in one place[/COLOR]
-Trakt, SIMKL, PunchPlay and MDBList now share a single Settings section called Tracking Accounts, the way the debrid services share Accounts. Each keeps its own block and its own settings; what changes is that they are no longer spread across three separate sections with MDBList tucked away among the metadata keys.
-Every setting kept its value. Nothing needs signing in again.
-SIMKL's account field was labelled "Trakt Username". It now says SIMKL, and the MDBList rows have proper labels instead of text typed straight into the settings file.
[COLOR fffdb515]The trailers settings say what they are for[/COLOR]
-That section was headed simply "Trailers", in the same grey as the text below it, so it was easy to miss what the settings underneath actually did. It is now headed Play Trailers, in the same colour as the other section headings.
-The line beneath it was long enough that Kodi cut it off with an ellipsis, right where the useful part was. It is now short enough to read in full; the setting it described is handled by the automatic setup button two rows below.
[COLOR fffdb515]Section headings look the same everywhere[/COLOR]
-The service names heading each block were in three different styles: some coloured, some plain, and some typed straight into the settings file. Trakt, SIMKL and PunchPlay were green while MDBList, Premiumize.me, Real-Debrid, All Debrid, TorBox and Easynews were not.
-All nine now share one colour and one weight, in Tracking Accounts and in Accounts alike.
-The sub-sections inside the Trakt block stay uncoloured, since they name parts of Trakt rather than services of their own, but they now match each other.
